biography: Kimberley Chong is a Level 63 at Microsoft, anticipating a senior promotion to Level 64 within six months. She recently moved to New York and works remotely for Microsoft's New Markets team, focusing on initial due diligence for data center site selection. Her expertise spans engineering, systems planning, and regulatory policy, which she applies to large load challenges in new data center regions across the Central and West US. She has 1.5 years of experience in site selection from a power perspective and 5 years in negotiating interconnection and transmission agreements. Kimberley enjoys the dynamic environment at Microsoft and the leeway to design the future of data centers responsibly, while her primary frustration is the prolonged decision-making process within the organization.
